mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_schedule_task (tenant_id, user_id, config_id, task_id, business_key, config_hash, config_version, cron_expr, timezone, misfire_policy, max_retries, planned_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, fencing_token, row_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{configId}, #{taskId}, #{businessKey}, #{configHash}, 1, #{cronExpr}, #{timezone}, #{misfirePolicy}, #{maxRetries}, #{plannedTime}, #{nextFireTime}, #{status}, 0, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tenant_id = VALUES(tenant_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), config_version = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), config_version + 1, config_version), cron_expr = VALUES(cron_expr), timezone = VALUES(timezone), misfire_policy = VALUES(misfire_policy), max_retries = VALUES(max_retries), planned_time = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), VALUES(planned_time), planned_time), next_fire_time = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), VALUES(next_fire_time), next_fire_time), retry_at = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), NULL, retry_at), retry_count = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), 0, retry_count), lease_owner = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), NULL, lease_owner), lease_until = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), NULL, lease_until), status = IF(NOT (config_hash <=> VALUES(config_hash)), VALUES(status), IF(VALUES(status) = 'disabled', 'disabled', IF(status = 'disabled', 'ready', status))), config_hash = VALUES(config_hash), row_version = row_version + 1, deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE agent_schedule_task task LEFT JOIN agent_schedule_config config ON config.config_id = task.config_id AND config.deleted = 0 SET task.status = 'disabled', task.lease_owner = NULL, task.lease_until = NULL, task.retry_at = NULL, task.row_version = task.row_version + 1 WHERE task.deleted = 0 AND task.status <> 'disabled' AND (config.config_id IS NULL OR config.enabled = 0 OR config.status <> 'active')

UPDATE agent_schedule_task SET status = 'running', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM ( SELECT id FROM agent_schedule_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('ready', 'retry', 'running') AND COALESCE(retry_at, next_fire_time) <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(retry_at, next_fire_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 ) candidate )
